cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
add = """
## capbypass.pro — solver cadangan (TERUJI, saldo ~$1.99)
```
key      : cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b
API      : POST https://api.capbypass.pro/createTask
           POST https://api.capbypass.pro/getTaskResult   (poll tiap 2-3 s)
           POST https://api.capbypass.pro/getBalance      {"clientKey":...}
biaya    : ~$0.0006 per task
```
### Hasil tes (17 Nov)
| Tipe | Hasil |
|---|---|
| `ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess` | **OK, skor 0.9**, ~2 detik |
| `ReCaptchaV3EnterpriseTaskProxyLess` | **OK** (untuk AllModels) |
| `TurnstileTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — sitekey HEX `0x4AAAAAAF3EU-q7sNrfjP5Q`, token 773 char |
| `GeetestTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — pakai `captchaId`, bukan `websiteKey` |
| `CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess` | diterima; data dummy gagal (butuh sitekey asli) |
| `AntiAwsWafTaskProxyLess` | diterima; data dummy gagal |
| `ReCaptchaV2TaskProxyLess` | **INACTIVE** di akun ini |
Tipe valid: ReCaptchaV2Task/ProxyLess, ReCaptchaV3Task/ProxyLess,
ReCaptchaV3EnterpriseTask/ProxyLess, TurnstileTask/ProxyLess,
HCaptchaTask/Proxyless, GeetestTaskProxyLess, CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess,
AntiAwsWafTaskProxyLess, CloudflareTask.
### Bandingkan dengan captchaai
- captchaai: Turnstile OK, tapi token reCAPTCHA v3 **skor rendah** -> AllModels tolak.
- capbypass: skor **0.9** -> jauh lebih mungkin diterima. **Pakai capbypass untuk reCAPTCHA.**
### Catatan
- Solusi Turnstile ada di `solution.token`; reCAPTCHA di `solution.gRecaptchaResponse`.
- Geetest butuh `captchaId` (contoh `fcd636b4514bf7ac4143922550b3008b`).
- Error `ERROR_TASK_TYPE_INACTIVE` = tipe tidak aktif di akun.
- `ERROR_INVALID_TASK_DATA` = sitekey/data salah (bukan saldo habis).
"""
t=t.replace("## Email / identitas", add.strip()+"\n\n## Email / identitas")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY

ok


grep -n "capbypass.pro — solver cadangan" AKSES.md
